# Rye Lane Bakery

The map. One-liners carry the numbers and the names; route on those, not on
filenames. Anything marked fast below has an `as_of` date on its page — quote the
date with the number.

## The wiki

- [Wholesale bread programme](wiki/wholesale-bread-programme.md) — the core offer: 40-loaf minimum weekly drop, 3 shapes, 06:30 delivery inside 6 km, 4-week notice to change volume. Slow.
- [Pricing](wiki/pricing.md) — £3.10 wholesale sourdough, £2.40 tin, 12 % off above 120 loaves/week; a 9 % flour rise is pending. **Fast — as of 2026-06-01.**
- [Order intake](wiki/order-intake.md) — orders lock 14:00 Thursday for the following week; changes after lock are quoted, never absorbed.
- [Ferren Cafe](wiki/ferren-cafe.md) — 85 loaves/week on the 12 % tier, 2-year account, currently asking about a second drop. **Fast — as of 2026-06-14.**

## Standing

- [Trading policy](standing/trading-policy.md) — what the bakery will and will not take on, who may quote, and the claims rules for anything a customer reads.

## Known gaps

- **Retail and market-stall side.** This brain covers wholesale only; counter pricing and market takings are not in the corpus.
- **Costs and margin.** Ingredient and labour costs are not ingested, so no answer here can say whether a price is profitable.
- **Accounts other than Ferren Cafe.** Only one client is written up; the other accounts exist and are not covered.
- **Stale by design:** the pending flour rise on [pricing](wiki/pricing.md) was unresolved at the last ingest, and the 2024 rate card in `raw/` disagrees with the current one — see the contradiction flag on that page.
